title: Recital: Surat Nuh whole: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 43 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recital rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 43. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: The message: worship Allah and fear Him
Nuh's efforts; istighfar; signs in creation
The people follow their leaders and idols

arabic.text: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا (٢٠) قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا (٢١)

questions.q: Chain recitation of Nuh 1 to 28, one ayah per pupil.
Recital: today's group recites Nuh whole to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the joins and log them.
Extend: recite 71:26 to 28 at a steady pace with full meaning in mind.
Which ayah begins Nuh's final du'a?
Recite Nuh 71:27 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: Nuh has a clear story order. How can the story help you remember which ayah comes next?
questions.a: The call (1 to 4), Nuh's report of his efforts (5 to 20), his people's rejection (21 to 24), the flood and his du'a (25 to 28).
